01-hero-v2.prompt: Edit the first reference image. Keep everything exactly as it is: the ring's position, size and angle, the camera, the light, the travertine, the wall, the patches of amber and teal light and all colours. Change only three details of the band. First, the groove: make it one single fine bright line, a thin V-cut about 0.3 mm wide, not two parallel lines and not a wide channel; it still runs around the band a little off centre and through the centre of the round stone. Second, the two edges of the band: make each edge a smooth, flat, high-polish bevel cut at an angle, one bright angled strip about 0.7 mm wide running all the way round, with no step, no ledge and no extra line beside it. Third, the gold rim around the stone: make it very thin, a fine line of polished gold barely wider than the groove, so the stone itself fills almost the whole circle. The stone stays the same size, round, bright and colourless, flush and level with the brushed face, the only stone on the ring. The second reference image is a close crop of this ring's design: take from it only the look of the single groove line, the angled bevel along the edge and the thin rim around the stone, not its background, colour or camera angle. Photorealistic, natural colour, no text, no logo, no watermark.
